injuries.name: Anthony Edwards
injuries.note: Edwards underwent a successful arthroscopic procedure on his right knee Thursday, the Timberwolves announced.

injuries.name: Paolo Banchero
injuries.note: Banchero is expected to be sidelined for the next four-to-six weeks due to a right high-ankle sprain.

injuries.name: Jaylen Brown
injuries.note: Brown (hamstring) underwent an MRI that showed no signs of a new injury or re-aggravation, but he didn't travel with the team for the road trip, so he will miss the team's next two games.

injuries.name: Lauri Markkanen
injuries.note: Markkanen has been diagnosed with a non-displaced fracture in his right hand and will be sidelined for at least one month.

injuries.name: Cade Cunningham
injuries.note: Cunningham (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: OG Anunoby
injuries.note: Anunoby (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat. The forward was previously listed as doubtful and will miss his third consecutive contest due to a left calf strain.

injuries.name: Kevin Porter Jr.
injuries.note: Porter won't play Saturday against the Wizards as he's still in the process of getting up to speed on his conditioning.

injuries.name: Kawhi Leonard
injuries.note: Leonard has begun individual on-court workouts following treatment to address swelling in his left knee, and he will be re-evaluated in one week.

injuries.name: Evan Mobley
injuries.note: Mobley will receive treatment and participate in rehab after the team confirmed a diagnosis of a right great toe sprain, and he'll be re-evaluated in the next 7-to-10 days.

injuries.name: Kon Knueppel
injuries.note: Knueppel (hamstring) was diagnosed with a left hamstring strain Sunday and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Jimmy Butler III
injuries.note: Butler (knee) could return sometime between January and February as he continues recovering from a torn right ACL.

injuries.name: Stephen Curry
injuries.note: Curry (abdomen/oblique) has been ruled out for each of the Warriors' next three games

injuries.name: Donte DiVincenzo
injuries.note: DiVincenzo (Achilles) has been cleared for team basketball activities and is targeting a return to game action in January.

injuries.name: RJ Barrett
injuries.note: Barrett has been diagnosed with a right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Jaren Jackson Jr.
injuries.note: Jackson has been diagnosed with a torn MCL in his right knee and will be sidelined for 6-to-8 weeks.

injuries.name: Bennedict Mathurin
injuries.note: Mathurin (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: CJ McCollum
injuries.note: McCollum (calf) will miss at least four weeks.

injuries.name: Jerami Grant
injuries.note: Grant was diagnosed with a grade 1 left calf strain and will be re-evaluated in two weeks.

injuries.name: Norman Powell
injuries.note: Powell has been diagnosed with a mild right hamstring strain and will be re-evaluated later this week.

injuries.name: Shaedon Sharpe
injuries.note: Sharpe suffered a torn meniscus in his knee and is expected to miss six months.

injuries.name: Chet Holmgren
injuries.note: Holmgren underwent a biological treatment Friday to address a small patellar tendon tear and will miss at least 8-10 weeks.

injuries.name: Grayson Allen
injuries.note: Allen (concussion) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Nets.

injuries.name: Ja Morant
injuries.note: Head coach Micah Nori said Morant met with a doctor in Los Angeles, who gave him a positive outlook on his recovery from the hamstring injury. While Nori declined to update Morant's timetable, he added Morant "may not be out for as long as we thought," Trail Blazers.

injuries.name: Jalen Williams
injuries.note: Williams (ankle) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Pacers, according to the NBA's official injury report.

injuries.name: Jalen Duren
injuries.note: Detroit recalled Duren (hamstring) from the G League's Motor City Cruise on Wednesday.

injuries.name: LaMelo Ball
injuries.note: Ball (ankle) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Grizzlies. The guard was previously questionable after spraining his left ankle during Wednesday's win over Oklahoma City.

injuries.name: Dejounte Murray
injuries.note: Murray (ankle) is out for Friday's game against Memphis.

injuries.name: Tobias Harris
injuries.note: Harris (calf) is likely to be sidelined until early December.

injuries.name: Duncan Robinson
injuries.note: Robinson (quadriceps) is out for Friday's game against the Bucks.

injuries.name: Cason Wallace
injuries.note: Wallace underwent surgery Friday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will be re-evaluated before the end of the regular season.

injuries.name: Maxime Raynaud
injuries.note: Raynaud (knee) was recalled from the G League's Stockton Kings on Wednesday.

injuries.name: Miles McBride
injuries.note: McBride (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Moses Moody
injuries.note: Moody (knee) is progressing toward a potential return between December and January after rupturing his left patellar tendon in March.

injuries.name: Dennis Schroder
injuries.note: Schroder (hamstring) is out for Wednesday's game the Bulls.

injuries.name: Kristaps Porzingis
injuries.note: Porzingis announced on his social media that he's stepping away from basketball.

injuries.name: Mark Williams
injuries.note: Williams underwent surgery Thursday to repair a torn labrum in his left shoulder and will miss an extended period of time.

injuries.name: Taurean Prince
injuries.note: Prince underwent arthroscopic right knee surgery Nov. 18 and will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Eric Vincent of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Isaiah Stewart
injuries.note: Stewart (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Timberwolves.

injuries.name: Dylan Harper
injuries.note: Harper (hip) participated in Friday's morning shootaround.

injuries.name: Dean Wade
injuries.note: Wade (hamstring) is out for Friday's game against the Pacers.

injuries.name: Nolan Traore
injuries.note: Traore will be re-evaluated in approximately 8-10 weeks due to a right hamstring strain, Michael Scotto of HoopsHype.com reports.

injuries.name: Jock Landale
injuries.note: Landale (hip) is out for Friday's game against the Celtics.

injuries.name: Jordan Miller
injuries.note: Miller underwent surgery Wednesday to repair a torn left rotator cuff and will be re-evaluated in six months.

injuries.name: Ben Sheppard
injuries.note: Head coach Rick Carlise confirmed Sheppard will miss "months" after undergoing surgery to repair a torn meniscus in his left knee, Tony East of Forbes.com reports.

injuries.name: GG Jackson
injuries.note: Jackson underwent a procedure Wednesday to repair a broken fifth metatarsal in his left foot. He is expected to recover fully and will be re-evaluated in approximately three months.

injuries.name: Vit Krejci
injuries.note: Krejci underwent surgery on his fractured left ankle Wednesday and will be re-evaluated in eight weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Scotty Pippen Jr.
injuries.note: Pippen (back) is out for Wednesday's game against the Clippers.

injuries.name: Jamir Watkins
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Thursday that Watkins has undergone surgery for a torn ACL.

injuries.name: Bradley Beal
injuries.note: Beal (knee) will not be ready for the start of the regular season, NBA writer.

injuries.name: Justin Champagnie
injuries.note: Champagnie (foot) is expected to miss several months.

injuries.name: Mitchell Robinson
injuries.note: Robinson has been ruled out Marc D'Amico of the Celtics' official sitefor Friday's game.

injuries.name: Jaylin Williams
injuries.note: Williams (back) is listed as out for Wednesday's game against Minnesota.

injuries.name: Andre Drummond
injuries.note: Drummond (concussion) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: Kasparas Jakucionis
injuries.note: Jakucionis (ankle) won't play Friday's game against the Pistons.

injuries.name: Jordan Clarkson
injuries.note: Clarkson (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Heat.

injuries.name: T.J. McConnell
injuries.note: McConnell (hamstring) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the 76ers, Alex Golden of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Dereck Lively II
injuries.note: Lively (foot) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Nikola Topic
injuries.note: Topic (hip) is out for Saturday's game against the Bucks, Brandon Rahbar of DailyThunder.com reports.

injuries.name: Nae'Qwan Tomlin
injuries.note: Tomlin (back) will remain on the inactive list for Wednesday's game against the Grizzlies.

injuries.name: Mouhamed Gueye
injuries.note: Gueye (foot) is ready to begin on-court activities and will be re-evaluated in four weeks.

injuries.name: Tristan Vukcevic
injuries.note: Vukcevic (hip) has been ruled out for Tuesday's game against Boston.

injuries.name: Jaylen Clark
injuries.note: Clark (hamstring) has been ruled out for the next two weeks.

injuries.name: Noah Penda
injuries.note: Penda (hamstring) is making progress but remains without a timetable to return to game action.

injuries.name: Moritz Wagner
injuries.note: Wagner (knee) won't be available for Friday's game against Toronto.

injuries.name: Asa Newell
injuries.note: Newell underwent surgery Tuesday for a plantar plate tear in his left great toe, and he will be re-evaluated in approximately four months.

injuries.name: Mo Bamba
injuries.note: Bamba (illness) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Nuggets.

injuries.name: Jonathan Isaac
injuries.note: Isaac (knee) is out for Sunday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Ariel Hukporti
injuries.note: Hukporti has sustained a season-ending ruptured right Achilles tendon.

injuries.name: Chris Youngblood
injuries.note: Youngblood (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Warriors.

injuries.name: Henri Veesaar
injuries.note: Veesaar was diagnosed with a torn right ACL and is expected to miss the 2026-27 season, the Hawks announced Monday.

injuries.name: Caleb Wilson
injuries.note: Wilson (hand) is expected to miss four to six weeks.

injuries.name: Kyrie Irving
injuries.note: Irving (knee) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Suns, Noah Weber of TheSmokingCuban.com reports.

injuries.name: Tobi Lawal
injuries.note: Lawal (groin) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Sergio de Larrea
injuries.note: De Larrea (knee) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Tarik Biberovic
injuries.note: Biberovic (heel) is out for Friday's game against the Suns.

injuries.name: Ebuka Okorie
injuries.note: The Pistons announced Tuesday that Okorie (oblique) will miss at least two weeks.

injuries.name: Tyrese Haliburton
injuries.note: Haliburton (hamstring) has been ruled out.com for Friday's game against the 76ers. The guard participated in practice activities earlier this week as he continues working toward his return.

injuries.name: Cameron Boozer
injuries.note: Boozer (ankle) will be re-evaluated in four weeks, Brett Siegel of ClutchPoints.com reports.

injuries.name: Richie Saunders
injuries.note: Saunders signed a two-way contract with the Grizzlies on Saturday.

injuries.name: Aday Mara
injuries.note: Mara (leg) is out for Saturday's game versus the Bucks.

injuries.name: Thomas Sorber
injuries.note: Sorber underwent an arthroscopic knee procedure Tuesday to address inflammation at the patellofemoral joint in his right knee, and he's expected to return to on-court activities in 6-8 weeks.

injuries.name: Izaiyah Nelson
injuries.note: Head coach Sean Sweeney said Wednesday that Nelson (ankle) has been doing "some on-court stuff," though Sweeney added that the work has been "minimal,".

injuries.name: Damian Lillard
injuries.note: Lillard (calf) has been ruled out for Friday's game against the Warriors. The veteran guard is dealing with right calf tightness and soreness.

injuries.name: Ben Simmons
injuries.note: Simmons underwent successful surgery Tuesday to repair a torn right Achilles tendon.

injuries.name: Jayden Quaintance
injuries.note: Quaintance has been around the team but has not yet been cleared for basketball activities, Matt Guzman of SI.com reports.

injuries.name: Nate Bittle
injuries.note: Bittle (foot) has been ruled out for Monday's game against the Bucks, Blake Murphy of Sportsnet.ca reports.

injuries.name: Reece Beekman
injuries.note: The Wizards announced Monday that Beekman sustained a right acromioclavicular joint injury and will be re-evaluated in approximately three weeks.

injuries.name: Zach LaVine
injuries.note: LaVine (knee) is listed as out for Wednesday's game versus the Warriors.

injuries.name: De'Aaron Fox
injuries.note: Fox (shin) is questionable for Friday's game against the Lakers.

injuries.name: Julian Reese
injuries.note: The Pelicans transferred Reese from the G League's Laketown Squadron, and he will be available for New Orleans' game against the Warriors on Monday.

injuries.name: Anthony Black
injuries.note: Black (back) is questionable for Saturday's game against the Wizards.

injuries.name: Steven Adams
injuries.note: Adams (knee) is questionable for Saturday's game against the 76ers.

injuries.name: Ryan Kalkbrenner
injuries.note: Kalkbrenner (hip) is probable for Saturday's matchup with Brooklyn.

injuries.name: Jalen Smith
injuries.note: Smith (illness) is listed as probable for Saturday's game against Indiana.

injuries.name: Colin Castleton
injuries.note: Castleton totaled five points (2-4 FG, 1-1 3Pt) and four rebounds in seven minutes during Tuesday's 132-116 preseason win over the Cavaliers.

injuries.name: Noa Essengue
injuries.note: Essengue (thumb) is probable to play Saturday against the Pacers.

Acquired G Rob Dillingham from Chicago Bulls for G Buddy Hield.
Acquired G Buddy Hield from Charlotte in exchange for G Rob Dillingham.
Waived G DJ Armstrong and C Tre Carroll. Acquired Gs Buddy Hield, Ryan Nembhard and cash considerations from Atlanta in exchange for F Dorian Finney-Smith.
Acquired G Micah Peavy, G Jordan Hawkins and draft considerations from New Orleans Pelicans for G AJ Johnson and F Taj Gibson.

Acquired SG Josh Green and cash considerations from Minnesota Timberwolves for Fs John Konchar and Cody Williams.

Acquired G Dennis Schroder from Cleveland.
Acquired G Tre Mann from Charlotte. Received draft considerations from LA Clippers.
Acquired G Max Strus from Cleveland.
Acquired draft considerations from Cleveland Guardians for G Peyton Watson.

Acquired G Ryan Nembhard from Dallas and G Luguentz Dort from Oklahoma City in a three-team trade that sent F Zaccharie Risacher to Dallas. Dallas received draft consideration from Atlanta, while Oklahoma City received draft considerations from Atlanta and Dallas.
Acquired G Grayson Allen, F Royce O'Neale and draft considerations from Phoenix Suns for F Miles Bridges and draft considerations.
Acquired F Miles Bridges and draft considerations from Charlotte in exchange for G Grayson Allen, F Royce O'Neale and draft considerations.
Acquired F Naz Reid and draft considerations from Minnesota Timberwolves for Gs LaMelo Ball and Josh Green.
Acquired F Julius Randle from Minnesota. Waived G Malachi Smith. Signed F Joshua Jefferson to a rookie scale contract.
Acquired Gs LaMelo Ball and Josh Green from Charlotte in exchange for F Naz Reid and draft considerations. Re-signed Gs Jaylen Clark and Ayo Dosunmo to a contract.
Acquired C Nic Claxton from Brooklyn.
Acquired G AJ Johnson and draft consideration from Dallas. Acquired G D'Angelo Russell and draft consideration from Washington. Acquired F Isaiah Stewart from Detroit.
Acquired F Khris Middleton and draft consideration from Dallas.
Acquired draft consideration from Los Angeles Lakers for C Walker Kessler.
Acquired G Caris Levert from Detroit.
Acquired C Walker Kessler from Utah in exchange for draft consideration.
Acquired F John Collins from the L.A. Clippers. Acquired F Taurean Prince and G Garry Harris from Milwaukee. Acquired draft consideration from Memphis.
Acquired F Santi Aldama from Memphis. Acquired G Marcus Sasser from Detroit.
Acquired G Jaden Hardy from Washington in exchange for draft considerations.
Acquired draft considerations from Atlanta Hawks for G Aaron Wiggins.
Signed G Anfernee Simons and F Dean Wade to contracts. Acquired G Jaylen Brown from the Boston Celtics. Signed C Ariel Hukporti to a contract.

Re-signed F Andrew Wiggins to a veteran extension. Acquired Fs Giannis Antetokounmpo and Bobby Portis from the Milwaukee Bucks in exchange for Gs Tyler Herro, Jaime Jaquez Jr. and Kasparas Jakucionis, C Kel'el Ware and draft considerations. Signed G Tim Hardaway Jr. to a contract.
Signed G Ebuka Okorie to a rookie scale contract. Acquired G Isaiah Joe from the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for draft considerations.

Acquired G Aaron Wiggins from the Oklahoma City Thunder in exchange for draft considerations.

Unit production = sum of projected per-game points/rebounds/assists (2025-26 per-minute rates x projected minutes).
